purpose: Quote speech or introduce a topic conversationally.
keywords: I heard that tomorrow is a day off.
My mother said to come home early.
restrictions: It can replace quotative と or introduce a topic; context distinguishes the functions.
mistake: It is generally unsuitable as a replacement in formal writing.

segments.role: Quote speech or introduce a topic conversationally. Quoted clause / noun + って.
